description: Send a GET to any Bokio API path that no other tool covers; {companyId} in the path is replaced with the company id. Returns the response body.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

path.description: API path below /v1, e.g. /companies/{companyId}/tag-groups; query values go in params

name: bokio_raw_get
